# QT Imaging Secures First GCC Commercial Order from American Hospital Dubai, Plans Clinical Research Collaboration


November 10, 2026 8:30am EST


PETALUMA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[QT Imaging Holdings, Inc.](http://www.qtimaging.com/) **** **(Nasdaq: QTI) (“QT Imaging” or the “Company”),** a medical device company dedicated to transforming breast health management through innovative, radiation-free imaging technology, today announced its first commercial order in the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) region for the QT Imaging Breast Acoustic CT™ scanner from American Hospital Dubai, through its regional distribution partner, Al Naghi Medical.


“American Hospital Dubai is precisely the type of clinical partner we want as we enter the GCC market,” said Satrajit Misra, Chief Commercial Officer of QT Imaging. “Its multidisciplinary Breast Institute and established breast imaging program provide an opportunity to evaluate our technology in clinical practice. Together with American Hospital Dubai, we aim to build clinical evidence, engage physicians, and open opportunities for adoption across the region. Despite the ongoing conflict and geopolitical uncertainty affecting parts of the Middle East, we continue to execute our commercial strategy across the GCC. This order demonstrates the resilience of our regional partnerships and the commitment of healthcare institutions such as American Hospital Dubai to advancing breast imaging technology, even under challenging circumstances.”


American Hospital Dubai was the first healthcare institution in the Middle East to join the Mayo Clinic Care Network and has received American Institute of Ultrasound in Medicine accreditation for diagnostic and interventional breast ultrasound. Its Breast Institute brings together advanced imaging, breast surgery, oncology, pathology, and high-risk patient care, providing a clinical setting in which the QT Imaging Breast Acoustic CT imaging modality can be evaluated alongside established breast imaging modalities.


Published research highlights significant unmet needs in breast cancer detection in the UAE. A 2023 study found that only 23% of surveyed women had undergone mammography, with concerns about pain and perceptions of unnecessary screening contributing to low participation.(1) The median diagnosis age for breast cancer is 48 years, with 50% of women presenting with locally advanced or metastatic disease. This is significantly below what is reported in Caucasian women in the Western world.(2) These findings provide a strong rationale for the planned collaboration with American Hospital Dubai to evaluate the clinical performance and patient acceptance of radiation-free, compression-free Breast Acoustic CT imaging, including its repeatable and reproducible quantitative breast tissue measurements.


**About American Hospital Dubai**


Established in 1996, American Hospital Dubai is a 254-bed private healthcare institution offering comprehensive medical and surgical services across more than 40 specialties. The hospital was the first in the Middle East to receive Joint Commission International accreditation and, in 2016, became the first healthcare organization in the region to join the Mayo Clinic Care Network. Its multidisciplinary Breast Institute provides comprehensive breast health services, including advanced imaging, diagnosis, surgical care, oncology, and high-risk patient management. For more information, visit[www.ahdubai.com](http://www.ahdubai.com/) .


**About QT Imaging**


QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: QTI) is a medical device company engaged in the research, development, and commercialization of innovative imaging systems that use low-frequency sound waves. QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. strives to improve global health outcomes. Its strategy is predicated upon the fact that medical imaging is critical to the detection, diagnosis, and treatment of disease and that it should be safe, affordable, accessible, and centered on the patient’s experience. For more information on QT Imaging Holdings, Inc., please visit the Company’s website at[www.qtimaging.com](http://www.qtimaging.com/) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/qt-imaging-holdings/) .


Breast Acoustic CT™ is a trademark of an affiliate of QT Imaging Holdings, Inc.

(2)“Clinical and Pathological Characteristics of Breast Cancer Among Emirati National Patients”,[Rafal R Iskanderian](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Iskanderian+RR&cauthor_id=38205569) ,[Ahmed Matalkah](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Matalkah+A&cauthor_id=38205569) ,[Aya Abdoh](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Abdoh+A&cauthor_id=38205569) ,[Asma Al Hashmi](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Al+Hashmi+A&cauthor_id=38205569) ,[Bassel Jallad](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Jallad+B&cauthor_id=38205569) ,[Fady Geara](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Geara+F&cauthor_id=38205569) ,[Stephen R Grobmyer](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/?term=Grobmyer+SR&cauthor_id=38205569) , Gulf J Oncolog, 2024 Jan;1(44):25-29.
